protocol.selection_rule: All ablation configurations and endpoint multiplier 0.0 were fixed before the V0.4 confirmation set; no confirmation result was used for selection.
protocol.external_pages: New public full-page sources are test-only simulated vertical cuts; they are not physical shredded-paper scans.

methods.traditional_v0_2: V0.2 hand-crafted compatibility, non-wrapping +/-3 px alignment, endpoint cost weight 1.0.
methods.traditional_no_endpoint: Same traditional method with only endpoint cost removed.
methods.learned_v03_no_augmentation: V0.3 12-D alignment-aware features/search, but clean observations only during training.
methods.learned_v03_without_alignment: Nuisance augmentation retained; V0.1 9-D features and no vertical-search alignment.
methods.learned_v03_full: V0.3 five-condition cycling, 12-D alignment-aware features/search, endpoint multiplier 0.0.
